invariants.rationale: profile is dereferenced throughout the method, so it must be non-null.
context is passed and used in method calls, so it must be non-null.
profile.getPartitionPaths() is iterated over, so must be non-null.
If pStat.getNumInserts() > 0, entries are added for each partitionPath; thus after the loop, all partitionPaths are keys.
There is a direct check linking hasOutputWorkLoadStats to access of the output stat map.
